scope: S3R design review of specs/008-agreed-documents-in-account-area (spec.md, sketch.md, decisions.md, research.md, plan.md, tasks.md), one reviewer, three lenses in order: spec-compliance, security, architecture. Finding ids carry the lens: SPEC-, SEC-, ARCH-. No diff. Also read: CONSTITUTION.md, CONTEXT.md (glossary grep), docs/pages.md (grep), docs/contributing/standards/testing.md, docs/adr/0004, mvp_compliance/{models.py (slug validator, Document, Version/Acceptance querysets and managers, subject_of), views.py, urls.py, menus.py, admin.py (slug handling), migrations/0007}, the three templates, tests/{urls.py, settings.py, test_migrations.py, test_views.py (TestNoMenuEntry, TestPageStrings and helpers), test_admin.py (catalog helpers, TestUserFacingStrings)}, pyproject.toml, specs/006 spec FR-014. Resolved packages read: flex_menu 0.4.6 (menu.py, apps.py), django-mvp 0.25.0 (mounted.py, menus.py, urls.py, views/account.py, templates/mvp/account/base.html, METADATA), Django 6.1.1 (contrib/auth/mixins.py, db/models/fields/__init__.py). Not read: tests/factories.py beyond use, docs/models.md, AGENTS.md, pages.css, demo/. Premises were also executed against the branch's prototype in a throwaway probe under /tmp/fs008probe (three URLconfs: both mounted, area only, package only); nothing in the repo was written. ORCHESTRATOR QUESTIONS, both sides of each rule: (1) CONFIRMED. A leaf whose view_name does not reverse is made invisible at flex_menu/menu.py:397-404 (resolve_url returns None at :517-547; research's :518 is the reverse() call, not the drop) and the parent keeps only visible children (:416-421). Other side: resolved -> match_url() at :407. Nothing else raises: get_required_url_params is only reached with kwargs (:491-515), and the failure cache lives on the per-request copy. Probe, area only: processed AccountCenterMenu = [overview], /account/ 200. Package only: processing does not raise, overview is dropped. flex_menu not installed: menus.py is never imported (flex_menu/apps.py:8-9), so no entry and no failure. (2) CONFIRMED. MountedApp.for_request (mvp/mounted.py:255-262) calls claiming_menu (:286-297) for a view no mount served; it returns the account app when AccountCenterMenu.process(request).selected, and shell() (:277-283) hands the sidebar that menu. Selection is by resolver_match.view_name (flex_menu/menu.py:618-621), not path equality as research.md says. Probe, both mounted: /legal/agreed/ 200, entry selected, shell app = AccountCenterApp. Other side, mvp.urls not mounted: mounts() is empty (:355-360), claim is None, shell is (None, None) so the sidebar falls back to AppMenu, and the prototype page answers 500 NoReverseMatch from reverse('account-center') in get_breadcrumbs (views.py:123). The plan's 404 is therefore needed, and FR-013 plus the 2026-10-01 clarification ('the entry and the page are absent') give it provenance. Other arms: a main app does not claim (:289-292) and a refusing app is skipped (:293-294); neither applies to the account area (check=True). (3) NO CONTRADICTION, with one watch item. AgreedDocumentsView's own dispatch() is first in the MRO; the only other dispatch definitions are LoginRequiredMixin (django/contrib/auth/mixins.py:71-74) and View. A reverse check placed before super().dispatch() answers 404 to anonymous and signed-in alike, as T012 asserts. Other side: with the area mounted, super().dispatch() reaches LoginRequiredMixin and an anonymous visitor gets 302 (probe: /accounts/login/?next=/legal/agreed/). Watch item for T013: the check must precede the super() call; after it, or in get()/get_context_data(), an anonymous visitor is redirected and T012's anonymous case fails. (4) CONFIRMED. validators are deconstructed (django/db/models/fields/__init__.py:699; 0007_document_slug.py already carries the RegexValidator), so makemigrations emits one AlterField as 0009. validators is in non_db_attrs (:159-171), so no SQL runs and no row is touched. tests/test_migrations.py:26-38 forbids only RunPython/RunSQL and :41-42 requires makemigrations --check clean, which T015 satisfies; ADR 0004 concerns data migrations only. Article IX's one-migration-per-PR is met. The validator must be a module-level callable so the migration can reference it by path, as plan.md already places it. Other side: Document.objects.create() and save() bypass field validators, which plan.md states, and route order still holds FR-014's second half. A document already published under 'agreed' keeps its slug read-only in the admin (admin.py:38-43), so its change form is not blocked. (5) FAITHFUL, with one small gap (SPEC-004). FS-006 FR-014 (specs/006 spec.md:261) is about 'the host project's menus or navigation'. AccountCenterMenu is django-mvp's own and built to be appended to (mvp/menus.py:171-173, docstring :10-25); mvp/mounted.py:35-36 draws the same line. The sibling test over AppMenu.children stays. (6) CONFIRMED CONSTANT. select_related('version__document') loads everything the templates read from an acceptance (version.number, version.status, accepted_at) and from entry.document (name, slug); entry.newer is used only for number and published_at, and the view reads version.document_id, so no lazy load. Measured on the prototype: 4 queries (session, user, acceptances, versions in force) with one acceptance and with fifty across ten documents plus a newer version. Other side: zero acceptances costs 3, because document__in of an empty set issues no query; SC-005 compares one against fifty, so this is not a defect. for_person() and subject_of() issue no query (models.py:814-823, 958-978). (7) Nothing material without provenance. Document-page layout: D1 and the refined spec. 404: FR-013. http_method_names: FR-010. Escaping test: Article V. Direct dependency: Article VII (django-mvp already requires django-flex-menus>=0.4.5). fold_after: FR-019/D5. The one speculative item is the URLconf walk in T014 (ARCH-001). SECURITY LENS: no finding. The route takes no argument and the query is scoped by request.user through for_person(); sign-in is required; the page has no form and refuses POST; nothing new is stored, no setting is read, no new field is exposed; the 404 for a project without the area precedes the sign-in redirect and discloses nothing. Mounting mvp.urls in tests/urls.py leaves the existing suite's results unchanged (437 passed, the same 6 prototype failures either way).

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] T001's done-when ('Full suite green') cannot be reached. The approved list template holds a pluralised string, and the two existing catalog helpers cannot read a plural on either side, so TestPageStrings::test_every_string_in_a_page_template_is_in_the_english_catalog[agreed_documents.html] fails however the en catalog is regenerated. No task plans the helper change, and it is an edit to pre-existing test code.
findings.evidence: mvp_compliance/templates/mvp_compliance/agreed_documents.html:31 uses {% blocktranslate count counter=... %}...{% plural %}...{% endblocktranslate %}, the only plural in the package. tests/test_views.py:851-864: BLOCKTRANSLATE_TAG captures the whole body, so template_msgids() returns the single msgid '%(counter)s earlier version you agreed to{% plural %}%(counter)s earlier versions you agreed to' (printed by running the helper). makemessages writes msgid and msgid_plural as two strings, so that msgid is in no catalog. tests/test_admin.py:41-44: PO_ENTRY_RE requires msgstr directly after msgid, so a plural entry (msgid, msgid_plural, msgstr[0]) is not captured at all. PAGE_TEMPLATES is a glob (tests/test_views.py:845-849), so the template is swept as soon as it exists; the test fails on the branch today. The template is approved and not under review, so the remedy is in the helpers. Requirement: FR-017 (every string translatable, guarded by this sweep) and tasks.md T001 done-when.
findings.reproduction: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_views.py -k TestPageStrings ; then print template_msgids() for agreed_documents.html and observe the '{% plural %}' msgid.
findings.suggested_fix: tasks.md T001: add 'tests/test_views.py::template_msgids yields the singular and the plural of a {% plural %} block as two msgids, and tests/test_admin.py::catalog_entries reads msgid_plural entries; no assertion is loosened'. Name it in plan.md under 'What is kept from the prototype, and what is rebuilt' so the edit to existing test helpers is authorised.

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] Ordering: T006 and T015 claim 'full suite green' but add Python strings whose en-catalog regeneration is deferred to T009 and T016. The existing sweep over Python strings fails in between, so those done-whens are unreachable as ordered. T008 has the same gap for the menu label.
findings.evidence: tests/test_admin.py:64-87 collects every literal passed to _/gettext/gettext_lazy in the package, and TestUserFacingStrings.test_every_string_is_translatable (tests/test_admin.py:1293-1302) asserts each is in the en catalog. Run on the branch: missing includes 'Documents you agreed to', the subtitle, 'Account Center' (views.py:115-123) and 'Agreements' (menus.py:15). tasks.md T006 adds the view's title, subtitle and breadcrumb and says 'T005 passes; full suite green'; the catalog is regenerated in T009. T015 adds the validator's message (Article VIII requires it wrapped) and says 'full suite green'; the catalog is regenerated in T016. Requirement: FR-017, Article VIII.
findings.suggested_fix: tasks.md: move 'en catalog regenerated' from T009 into T006 and T008, and from T016 into T015 (each task that adds a string regenerates the catalog). No new task.

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] docs/pages.md states twice that the package adds nothing to a project's menus. After T008 the package appends an entry to the account area's menu, and no documentation task corrects the statement.
findings.evidence: docs/pages.md:22 and docs/pages.md:86-88 ('The package adds nothing to your menus: which pages appear in navigation is your decision'). plan.md 'Documentation' and tasks.md T009/T016 add sections on the list and on mounting, and do not touch these lines. Requirement: FR-018 and Article VI (docs ship with the public change); decisions.md D2 already draws the distinction the page needs.
findings.suggested_fix: tasks.md T009: add 'docs/pages.md intro and The menu section: the package adds nothing to the project's own menu (AppMenu), and one entry to the account area's menu'.

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] The narrowed TestNoMenuEntry assertion (D2) guards AppMenu only. FS-006 FR-014 covers the host project's 'menus or navigation', and django-mvp gives a project two menus of its own: the sidebar and the mobile dock.
findings.evidence: specs/006-documents-readable-as-pages/spec.md:261. mvp/menus.py:8-9 lists AppMenu (the sidebar) and MobileFooterMenu (the mobile dock) as the project's menus, with AccountCenterMenu (:10-13, :171-184) the one an installed app adds to. Today's test (tests/test_views.py:829-839) refuses any mention of flex_menu, which covers the dock; the narrowed one would not fail if the package appended to MobileFooterMenu.
findings.suggested_fix: tasks.md T007 and decisions.md D2: the narrowed test asserts no module in the package names AppMenu or MobileFooterMenu.

findings.claim: [architecture] The URLconf walk in T014 (every fixed route's segment is in Document.RESERVED_SLUGS) guards a second fixed route that does not exist. With one route it asserts only that 'agreed' is reserved, which TestReservedSlug already proves, and D3's own 'revisit if' says a second fixed route would be met with a prefix, not a longer reserved set.
findings.evidence: plan.md 'The route and the reserved slug' ('so a later fixed route cannot be added without reserving it'); tasks.md T014; decisions.md D3 'Revisit if'. mvp_compliance/urls.py has one fixed route. Article II (YAGNI over speculation). FR-014's two halves are each covered without the walk: the refusal by TestReservedSlug, and 'never answers with a document' by the document-created-from-code case.
findings.suggested_fix: tasks.md T014 and plan.md: drop the URLconf walk; keep 'with a document created from code under the slug agreed, the list's address still serves the list'.

findings.claim: [architecture] T014 places the admin add-form case in tests/test_models.py. Its subject is mvp_compliance/admin.py, which tests/test_admin.py mirrors.
findings.evidence: tasks.md T014 ('tests/test_models.py::TestReservedSlug ... the admin's add form refuses it and saves nothing'). docs/contributing/standards/testing.md section 4, 'Mirror the source tree'. tests/test_admin.py exists and holds the admin's slug tests.
findings.suggested_fix: tasks.md T014: keep the full_clean() case in tests/test_models.py::TestReservedSlug and put the add-form case in tests/test_admin.py.

notes: The schema allows one top-level lens and no per-finding lens field, so each finding carries its lens in its id prefix and at the start of its claim. The security lens produced no finding.

research.md 'How the page comes to sit inside the account area': 'Menu items match on exact URL equality with the request path' is stale for the resolved flex_menu 0.4.6, which matches on resolver_match.view_name (flex_menu/menu.py:618-621) and falls back to path comparison only for url-configured items.
research.md cites flex_menu/menu.py:518 for dropping an unresolvable entry; :518 is the reverse() call, and the drop is at :397-404.
research.md cites mvp/views/account.py:51 for the name account-center; it is declared at :52-53.
plan.md names the fold attribute fold_after; the prototype and sketch.md call it shown_first.

tasks.md T010 'the query count is unchanged from T005's' reads as an absolute number, but T011 adds the second query. It should say the same one-versus-fifty comparison holds. A user with no acceptances costs one query fewer than a user with any.
pyproject.toml:152 justifies the DEP002 ignore with 'no Python module here imports' django-mvp; views.py already imports mvp.views and menus.py will import mvp.menus.
T013 watch item: the account-center reverse check must come before super().dispatch(), or an anonymous visitor is redirected to sign in and T012's anonymous 404 fails.
